basic_details.job_title: DAU Post-doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Smart Energy Learning Centre (SELC) at Dhirubhai Ambani University (DAU), Gandhinagar, a research centre funded by BSES Delhi, has invited applications for one full-time, fixed-term Post-doctoral Fellow position in the project "Improving Efficiency of Solar Energy Harvesting using Metasurface Design". The fellowship is INR 75,000 per month, the appointment runs till 30 March 2027, and a detailed CV with a cover letter must be emailed to the PI at [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae and a Cover Letter.
Send both by email to the PI at [email protected] by 30 November 2026.
Write "Application for Post-doctoral Fellow position for project CSR-25/BSES/A10-PK/SELC" in the subject line of the email.
The notice names no other documents and prints no application form.
important_instructions: Shortlisted candidates attend the interview at their own expense; no TA/DA will be provided. The position is temporary and gives no right to claim an extension or absorption at DAU, Gandhinagar.

content_sections.heading: DAU Post-doctoral Fellow - RF-Microwave at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify an application fee.

rows.details: Improving Efficiency of Solar Energy Harvesting using Metasurface Design

content_sections.heading: About DAU
content_sections.text: Dhirubhai Ambani University is located in Gandhinagar, India, and the notice also refers to it as DAU and DA-IICT. The Smart Energy Learning Centre is described in the notice as a new research centre at DA-IICT funded by BSES Delhi, India. The post is advertised under the notice reference CSR-25/BSES/A10-PK/SELC.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites highly motivated candidates with good academic records. The essential qualifications are given below as printed. PhD with specialization in RF-Microwave. A candidate with a thesis submitted letter can also apply. M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics and communication engineering, VLSI, ICT, with at least 60% marks. B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and communication Engineering, ICT or equivalent, with at least 70% marks. Preference may be given to GATE-qualified candidates. Strong command of oral and written English. Desirable qualifications: Proficiency with programming and modeling software (e.g. CST, Matlab, Python). Prior exposure to metasurface related devices. The notice states "No Age Limits" as the upper age. Refer to the official notice for the discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is INR 75,000 per month for 1 post. The notice describes the position as full-time and fixed-term. It is temporary, with an appointment till 30 March 2027. The appointment does not confer any right on the candidate to claim an extension or absorption at DAU, Gandhinagar. The expected start date is 7 December 2026 or after.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAU Post-doctoral Fellow - RF-Microwave
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae and a Cover Letter. Send both by email to the PI at [email protected] by 30 November 2026. Write "Application for Post-doctoral Fellow position for project CSR-25/BSES/A10-PK/SELC" in the subject line of the email. The notice names no other documents and prints no application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. During the interview, candidates' knowledge will be assessed in the areas of RF-Microwave, Metasurface Design, Matlab, CST and Python programming. The interview is tentatively scheduled for the week starting 1 December 2026 and will be hybrid or online.

rows.event: Last date to send application by email

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates attend the interview at their own expense; no TA/DA will be provided. The position is temporary and gives no right to claim an extension or absorption at DAU, Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q1. How many Post-doctoral Fellow posts are there at DAU?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Post-doctoral Fellow (RF-Microwave) in the Smart Energy Learning Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The CV and cover letter must be emailed by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DAU Post-doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a PhD with specialization in RF-Microwave (a thesis submitted letter is also accepted), or M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics and communication engineering, VLSI, ICT with at least 60% marks, or B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and communication Engineering, ICT or equivalent with at least 70% marks, plus strong oral and written English.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an age limit?
faq.answer: The notice says "No Age Limits".

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The fellowship is INR 75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a detailed CV with a cover letter to the PI at [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for Post-doctoral Fellow position for project CSR-25/BSES/A10-PK/SELC".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, which tests RF-Microwave, Metasurface Design, Matlab, CST and Python programming. It is tentatively in the week starting 1 December 2026, in hybrid or online mode.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is temporary, with an appointment till 30 March 2027, and it gives no right to an extension or absorption at DAU, Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Shortlisted candidates attend the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA is provided.
